_comment: Figma asset manifest for the built pages. Node ids are recorded so any asset can be re-exported if a URL expires. Figma export URLs live about 7 days from the date they were pulled; the original set was pulled 15 Sep 2026. Entries carrying their own `fileKey` come from the designer's updated copy (jWPItVReOYx661IlH738fg) rather than the top-level file, and were pulled 16 Sep 2026. Run `node scripts/fetch-figma-assets.mjs --missing` to pull only what is not on disk.
